::: remark

A [proof by induction](proof-writing.qmd#def-proof-by-induction) proves a [proposition](proof-writing.qmd#def-proposition) about every [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) from some starting integer on.
A [sequence](functions.qmd#def-sequence) defined by a rule on its earlier [terms](functions.qmd#def-sequence-term) is the usual place to use it.
This page defines such [sequences](functions.qmd#def-sequence),
then adds the stronger form, [strong induction](induction.qmd#def-strong-induction), that they often need.

:::
